## Hypothesis

The current BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON captures J's PUT winners but suffers negative P&L on 4/29 and 5/01 due to weak VIX and shallow level rejection. Adding a stricter VIX filter (≥ 18) and a minimum level‑rejection depth (≥ 0.5 % below the prior resistance) should improve trade quality on those days, raising edge_capture above the 771 floor while preserving the strong 5/04 winner.

## Mechanism

Same entry logic (level rejection + EMA ribbon flip + confluence) but with two additional filters: (1) as‑of VIX must be ≥ 18 (or rising) for puts; (2) the rejection candle must close at least 0.5 % below the prior resistance level. Exit unchanged (chart‑stop primary, TP1 at +100 % premium, runner). This reduces false entries on weak days and improves average winner size.
